basic_info.description: Charming Bernal Heights Bungalow with Garden Oasis Near Precita Park. Welcome to 99 Manchester Street, a delightful bungalow nestled on the coveted north slope of Bernal Heights, just steps from the vibrant greenery of Precita Park. This inviting home blends classic San Francisco charm with modern urban convenience, offering a serene retreat in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods.  Set on a quiet, tree-lined street, this residence features a lush private garden, perfect for morning coffee, weekend gatherings, or simply unwinding amidst nature. Inside, the home exudes warmth and character, with cozy living spaces, period details, and abundant natural light.  Enjoy the best of city living with the Mission District's dynamic culture, dining, and nightlife just a short stroll away. Commuters will appreciate the easy access to BART and major transit lines, making downtown and the greater Bay Area effortlessly reachable.  Whether you're drawn to the community feel of Bernal Heights, the nearby parks and trails, or the energy of the Mission, 99 Manchester Street offers the perfect balance of tranquility and connectivity.
